subject: Staged MAP: commit ramp + observability & support credits
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elenor Hughes <elenor@optix.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP proposal and phased commit schedule

Hi Elenor —

Great talking yesterday. Per our discussion, I put together a staged MAP that aligns milestones to commit levels so Optix can ramp safely while securing discounted unit pricing and add-on credits as usage crosses milestones. High level: 

- Phase 0 (Pilot, 30 days): 4 vCPUs equivalent hosted evaluation, up to 1M tokens/month. No charge beyond credits.
- Phase 1 (Ramp month 1–3): Commit 250k tokens/day average, 10% off list pricing, +2 weeks observability retention (30 -> 44 days) included.
- Phase 2 (Sustained): Commit 1.0M tokens/day, 22% off list pricing, premium support included (P1 response SLA), plus 50k add-on credits for burst usage.

I've attached a draft MAP workbook (redwood_map_v2.xlsx) and a starter SOW. Two asks: (1) can you share procurement contact for SOW routing, and (2) does the phased ramp cadence above look feasible internally?

If that looks good I'll loop in Aditya to confirm discount bands and finalize the observability retention pricing line.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0119

Attachments: redwood_map_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_v1.pdf

From: Elenor Hughes <elenor@optix.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP proposal and phased commit schedule

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few quick notes from product and finance:

- Pilot looks fine. We want a short acceptance checklist (latency under 200ms p95 on a 512-token seq and embedding parity checks).
- Ramp cadence: product prefers a slightly slower ramp — Phase 1 target of 150k tokens/day for first 45 days then jump to 500k/day. Would that still qualify for the 10% discount or do we need a custom band?
- Observability: we do need 60 days retention for compliance on a subset of logs (an extra premium). Can you provide a line item for 60-day retention and a blended price if we commit to Phase 2 within 90 days?

Procurement contact is procurement@optix.ai — I'll CC them on the next exchange.

Best,
Elenor Hughes
Head of Product, Optix Health
elenor@optix.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Optix MAP - pricing options and retention tiers (internal)

Jordan / Aditya —

Reviewed Optix ask: slower ramp but wants 60-day observability retention for a subset and a blended discount if they commit to Phase 2 inside 90 days. My quick take: 

1) Discount bands: keep published bands but allow interpolation for partial ramps. For 150k -> 500k path, we can offer a 12% blended discount if they commit to Phase 2 within 90 days.
2) Observability: baseline 30-day included in Phase 1, 60-day subset retention can be offered as an add-on at $0.012 per GB/day. Propose a rebate (50% credit of observability charges for first 60 days) if they hit Phase 2 within 90 days (to make the evaluation economics friendlier).
3) Credits: propose 25k immediate add-on credits at contract signing, plus additional 25k when Phase 2 is acknowledged.

I attached a quick pricing sheet (observability_pricing_sheet.csv) with computed examples.

Thoughts?
Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Optix MAP - pricing options and retention tiers (internal)

Team —

Love the structured approach. Approve the 12% blended discount and the observability rebate concept conditionally (subject to sign by Oct 31). Two guardrails: 

- Total revenue commitment for Year 1 must be >= $320k ARR equivalent to justify the retention rebate. If their committed ramp doesn't meet that, we keep the standard 30-day retention and offer observability at list price.
- Premium support (P1 SLA) moves to included only at Phase 2 commit. Until then provide phone coverage during business hours.

Jordan — when you send the external note please present the blended discount, the observability add-on price and the conditional rebate language (sign by Oct 31 + Phase 2 within 90 days). Also list the credit mechanics (25k now, 25k on Phase 2 ack).

Aditya Rao
Director, Commercial
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elenor Hughes <elenor@optix.ai>, procurement@optix.ai
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal update: blended discount + observability rebate (MAP v2)

Elenor / procurement team —

Thanks again for the feedback. Attached is MAP v2 and a short SOW reflecting the adjustments (redwood_map_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_v1.pdf). Summary of key commercial points: 

- Ramp cadence: Pilot (30d) -> Phase 1 (150k tokens/day for first 45 days, then up to 500k/day) -> Phase 2 (1.0M tokens/day sustained).
- Pricing: 12% blended discount for the 150k->500k ramp path if Optix signs by Oct 31 and confirms Phase 2 commitment inside 90 days of go-live.
- Observability: 60-day retention (subset of logs) available at $0.012/GB/day. Conditional rebate: 50% rebate on observability charges for the first 60 days if Phase 2 commit achieved within 90 days.
- Credits & support: 25k add-on credits at signing, additional 25k upon Phase 2 acknowledgement. Premium P1 support included at Phase 2.

Next steps: please confirm by reply if procurement can accept these terms and we'll circulate a SOW for signature. If you want any language tweaks I can loop legal in for a quick redline.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_map_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_v1.pdf, observability_pricing_sheet.csv

From: procurement@optix.ai
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elenor Hughes <elenor@optix.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal update: blended discount + observability rebate (MAP v2)

Jordan / team —

Procurement has reviewed the terms. Two comments before legal routing: 

1) Can you convert the observability rebate into a credit line in the SOW (so it appears as a contract credit rather than a retrospective rebate)? That helps our accounting.
2) We need a clause that defines "Phase 2 acknowledgement" operationally (we propose: Optix confirms capacity hit for 30 consecutive days at >= 90% of Phase 2 target AND both sides sign an amendment acknowledging the milestone).

If you can add those two items we'll be able to move to legal review quickly and target a signature by Oct 28.

procurement@optix.ai
Optix Health Procurement
